name: n8n-to-claude
description: Move n8n workflows onto Claude. A fit report classifies every workflow in an export with the reason (scheduled task, skill, artifact form, hosting, or stays in n8n), then each one that fits becomes a self-contained folder: a definition a code runner executes step by step, the task prompt and permissions, and an artifact page with the graph and Run now. Cutover turns n8n off before Claude goes on.
